tickerText: [TENNIS] Rolex Paris Masters final Sunday at 3 p.m. CET: Carlos Alcaraz and Ben Shelton meet after Alcaraz beat Ruud 6-4, 6-4 and Shelton rallied past Van Assche 5-7, 6-3, 6-4 • [SQUASH] Paul Coll won his second U.S. Open title in Philadelphia, beating Diego Elias 11-8, 11-5, 11-6, 11-8 after dropping the opener in the PSA Platinum final • [BADMINTON] Korea Open finals Sunday at Jinnam Stadium: home fans saw Kim Yu-jung–Lee Yu-lim take women's doubles silver in a 113-rally epic before An Se Young faced Akane Yamaguchi for singles gold • [PICKLEBALL] Opendoor PPA Worlds Championship Sunday from 10 a.m. CT at Brookhaven as the 3,000-point season finale crowns five pro champions live on PickleballTV • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Champions Frankfurt semifinals Sunday at Süwag Energie Arena after Saturday's quarterfinals ended with no Chinese survivors and Franziska, Togami, Lin and Harimoto in the men's last four

newsItems.title: Paris Final Sunday
newsItems.excerpt: Alcaraz and Shelton renew their US Open quarterfinal rivalry in Sunday's Paris final after straight-set and three-set semifinal wins over Ruud and Van Assche.

newsItems.title: Yeosu Finals Day
newsItems.excerpt: Korea Open closes at Jinnam Stadium with Kim Yu-jung–Lee Yu-lim's women's doubles runner-up finish and An Se Young bidding for an 11th title of 2026 against Akane Yamaguchi.

newsItems.title: Frankfurt Semis Set
newsItems.excerpt: China's last four players fell in Frankfurt quarterfinals as Patrick Franziska, Shunsuke Togami, Lin Yun-Ju and Tomokazu Harimoto advanced to Sunday semifinals.

newsItems.title: Worlds Title Sunday
newsItems.excerpt: Brookhaven hosts PPA Worlds Championship Sunday with first serve at 10 a.m. CT and PickleballTV coverage from 11 a.m.–5 p.m. ET across five pro divisions.
